newsitem.title: USA: Huntington in deal to buy Citi-Bancshares.
newsitem.headline: Huntington in deal to buy Citi-Bancshares.

text.p: Huntington Bancshares Inc and Citi-Bancshares Inc said on Thursday that they have signed a definitive agreement with respect to Huntington's acquisition of Citi-Bancshares, a bank holding company headquartered in Leesburg, Florida.
Citizens National Bank, a subsidiary of Citi-Bancshares, operates eight banking offices in the Leesburg, Florida area, including Lake and Sumter Counties and two in Marion County.
It had total assets of about $524 million at September 30 and earned an annualized return of 1.52 percent on average assets for the first nine months of this year, a statement from Huntington said.
The statement said it is intended that Citizens National Bank will be merged into The Huntington National Bank of Florida, a subsidiary of Huntington Bancshares.

The shareholders of Citi-Bancshares can elect to receive Huntington Bancshares Inc common stock and/or cash for their shares of Citi-Bancshares in a purchase method of accounting transaction, the statement said.
The acquisition is expected to be completed in the first quarter of 1997, the statement said.
